comment: Sniper Rifle and Ranged Sweeper development range. FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0, FRAGR_QA_MAP_FILE=server/maps/test/sniper-range.json, FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/sniper-range.json. Real human input and server phases, no granted equipment or teleports. The scope is held through ordinary input; it is presentation and never decides a hit. Not a mission.

states.name: sniper_range_rack
states.note: Claim the Sniper Rifle, its Cells, the Shotgun and the Railgun through the normal supply path.

states.name: sniper_open_view
states.note: The unscoped Sniper Rifle and the dormant marksman's platform 76 metres away across the field, before its group wakes.

states.name: sniper_scoped_view
states.note: The same view through the held scope: the antenna mast and rifle read at range. The overlay is presentation only.

states.name: marksman_glint_duck_rise
states.note: Step onto the firing step and hold until a clear glint begins, drop behind the sill until the server cancels that windup without a shot, then rise and take the marksman first with one scoped Sniper shot.

states.name: sniper_range_after
states.note: The cleared platform from behind the window wall. The flank lane and the second shotgun answer remain open.
